$comment: verify-pacman registry (#1402). One entry per drive case: script (repo-relative), default args, needs (stack = vp.mjs launch first; vp.mjs drive runs doctor for these; fresh-stack = a stack nothing was driven on since launch, vp.mjs drive refuses otherwise unless --force; own-stack = the probe starts and stops its own stack, vp.mjs drive refuses while a stack is up in VERIFY_RUN_DIR; real-llm, github and rewrites-evidence mean the case spends model tokens, calls GitHub or rewrites committed docs/verify evidence, so vp.mjs drive asks for --force), status (current | stale | host-bound; non-current cases need --force), purpose, optional usage (script arguments, passed after --, which replace the default args they name (the same option before '=', or the same probe or journey name) while the other defaults stay; a probe that runs its pre-fix mode without arguments gets the post-fix flag as args), optional runner tsx with cwd (the repo-relative package directory whose tsx runs the script), optional evidence for a probe that does not read VERIFY_EVIDENCE_DIR: {flag} = vp.mjs passes the drive's evidence directory through that option (or uses the value given after --), {writes} = the probe writes its evidence to that path by design and vp.mjs creates no directory for it, {env} = the probe reads the directory from that variable. needsArgs = the usage names required positional arguments; vp.mjs drive refuses to run the case without a positional argument after --. recipe = the feature file, null when the feature has no map entry yet. support lists scripts that are not drive cases. New cases go here, not into new drive-<ticket>.mjs files: scripts/vp-registry-gate.mjs (run by the self-test in CI) fails on a script in scripts/ that is not registered, on a new script named drive-<number>, and on a feature map that does not name its vp.mjs drive line.

cleanup.mjs.purpose: Tears down the launch.mjs stack using its pid files (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL), reaps leftover daemons tied to this stack's server port, and deletes VERIFY_RUN_DIR. Evidence is kept.

doctor.mjs.purpose: Read-only health check: it confirms the process group is alive, the ports answer, and the auth session, teams and projects endpoints return 200.

drive.mjs.purpose: Multi-probe dispatcher for board, new-task, api-key, search and theme; registered per probe under its feature.

launch.mjs.purpose: Starts an isolated verify stack: the server on 8791 and vite on 5273, with a scratch PACMAN_HOME and skills dir. It writes pid files and ports.json.

setup-branch-sync-seed.mjs.purpose: Creates the todo/build plus a dirty git origin/target in /tmp with the step checkpoint at C2; prints ids and apiKey JSON

setup-review-seed.mjs.purpose: Seeds provider/agent/project/todo and a machine driving plan to confirm phase; prints ids JSON.
